public_rationale: Reported difficulties support the claim, despite initial ease.
limitations: This assessment does not establish that every participant failed.
A general conclusion about non-coders would require verified participant backgrounds, consistent task requirements, and independent testing of the resulting games.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: In The Guardian's test, people using AI tools without coding knowledge did not succeed well at building a Pac-Man clone.

statement.excerpt: I don’t want spoil all the fun, but … things didn’t go well:

our_interpretation: Read the statement as a limited description of substantial difficulties in the reported attempts, not as a claim that every attempt failed completely.
Assess the findings of the particular Guardian report as published on March 11, 2025; this does not date every participant's coding session.
The separate characterization of the participants as seven people without coding knowledge is not assumed to be established by this outcome.
criteria.support_condition: The original account documents substantial implementation or debugging difficulties in the attempts.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The original account describes consistently straightforward production of satisfactory, functioning clones.
